muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر﴾: اقتربت الساعة is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); and انشق القمر is conjoined to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿وإن يروا آية يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إن is conditional; يروا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); يعرضوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); يقولوا is conjoined to ﴿يعرضوا﴾; سحر is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هذا (this); and مستمر is a naʿt (adjective) of سحر.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وكذبوا واتبعوا أهواءهم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; كذبوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); اتبعوا is a verb and its fāʿil; and أهواءهم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وكل أمر مستقر﴾: the wāw is for resumption; كل أمر is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and مستقر is its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. It has been said: كل is a mubtadaʾ and the khabar is omitted, i.e.: acted upon; or it is conjoined to الساعة.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿ولقد جاءهم من الأنباء ما فيه مزدجر﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām falls in the answer to an implied oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); جاءهم is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ومن الأنباء is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ما; ما is relative or an indefinite qualified noun (mawṣūfa), and on both views it is the fāʿil (agent) of جاءهم; وفيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ومزدجر: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿فيه مزدجر﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿حكمة بالغة﴾: حكمة is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), or a badal (substitute) from ﴿ما﴾ in the previous ayah; بالغة is a naʿt (adjective) of حكمة; and the object of بالغة is omitted, the implied form being: reaching its goal.
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and ما is negating, i.e.: the warnings availed nothing. Or ﴿ما﴾ is interrogative, for disapproval, in the position of the accusative as a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being: so what availing do the warnings avail?; or in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the implied form being: so what thing do the warnings avail?
﴿تغن﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ, which was dropped in connected speech because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.
﴿النذر﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of تغن.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿فتول عنهم يوم يدع الداع إلى شيء نكر﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); تول is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: أنت (you); وعنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تول﴾; يوم is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿يخرجون﴾, or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: اذكر (remember); the clause يدع is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الداعي is the fāʿil of يدعو; وإلى شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدعو﴾; and نكر is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شيء﴾.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿خشعا أبصارهم يخرجون من الأجداث﴾: خشعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) in ﴿يخرجون﴾; أبصارهم is the fāʿil of the resembling adjective (al-ṣifa al-mushabbaha) ﴿خشعًا﴾, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma, and the third-person pronoun is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); يخرجون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; ومن الأجداث: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخرجون﴾; and the clause ﴿يخرجون﴾ has no grammatical position because it is resumptive.
﴿كأنهم جراد منتشر﴾: كأن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) of comparison; the third-person pronoun is in the position of the accusative as the noun of kaʾanna; جراد is the khabar (predicate) of kaʾanna, nominative with the ḍamma; منتشر: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿جراد﴾; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil in ﴿يخرجون﴾.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿مهطعين إلى الداع يقول الكافرون هذا يوم عسر﴾: مهطعين is accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), also from the fāʿil (agent) of يخرجون; وإلى الداع is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مهطعين﴾; the clause يقول الكافرون is resumptive, as if it came as an answer to a question arising from the description of the day with its terrors and of its people with their evil state; or the clause is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of يخرجون, so the ḥāls from the wāw are then four: one placed before and three placed after; and the clause هذا يوم عسر is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح فكذبوا عبدنا وقالوا مجنون وازدجر﴾: كذبت is a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; قبلهم is an adverb (ẓarf) of time, accusative (manṣūb), by virtue of its annexation [Translator's note: so in the source, «منصوب لإضافته»], attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾; قوم نوح is the fāʿil (agent) of كذبت; فكذبوا: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and كذبوا is a verb and its fāʿil; عبدنا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); قالوا is conjoined to كذبوا; مجنون is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هو مجنون (he is a madman); وازدجر is conjoined to قالوا, i.e.: they were not content with this saying, but added to it his rebuking and repelling; and it has been said: it is conjoined to هو مجنون, so it falls within the scope of what they said, i.e.: they said: he is a madman, and he was driven away; ازدجر is a past verb, passive (built for the one whose agent is not named).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿فدعا ربه أني مغلوب فانتصر﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; دعا ربه is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أن with what falls in its scope is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and مغلوب is its khabar (predicate); the fāʾ is conjunctive; انتصر is an imperative verb; and what انتصر is attached to (its mutaʿalliq) is omitted.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿ففتحنا أبواب السماء بماء منهمر﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, conjoining to an omitted, implied clause, i.e.: so We answered Nūḥ's supplication and opened; فتحنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أبواب السماء is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وبماء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فتحنا﴾, and the bāʾ is for transitivity (al-taʿdiya), by way of hyperbole, since the water is made like the instrument with which one opens; or the bāʾ is for accompaniment (al-mulābasa), i.e.: accompanied by pouring water, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿منهمر﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ماء﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وفجرنا الأرض عيونا﴾: فجرنا is conjoined to فتحنا; الأرض is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and عيونًا is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿فالتقى الماء على أمر قد قدر﴾: فالتقى is conjoined to فجرنا; الماء is the fāʿil (agent) of التقى; وعلى أمر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) التقى, and ﴿على﴾ conveys the meaning of causation (al-taʿlīl); it has been said: it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause قد قدر is a naʿt (adjective) of أمر.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿وحملناه على ذات ألواح ودسر﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; حملناه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وعلى ذات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حملناه﴾; ألواح is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and دسر is conjoined to ألواح.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿تجري بأعيننا جزاء لمن كان كفر﴾: the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ذات دسر, and ذات ألواح is originally a naʿt of an (omitted) سفينة (ship), so this is a second naʿt; تجري is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of its nominative is a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ; وبأعيننا is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in تجري, i.e.: guarded and protected under Our eyes; جزاء is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or it is with an implied جازيناهم جزاء (We requited them a requital), or it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl; ولمن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جزاء; and the clause كان is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿ولقد تركناها آية فهل من مدكر﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); تركناها is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the pronoun refers back to the deed, which is their drowning in the manner mentioned, and it has been said: it refers back to the ship; آية is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a second mafʿūl bihi if تركنا has the meaning of جعلناها (We made it); the fāʾ is conjunctive; هل is an interrogative particle; من is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; and مدكر is genitive in form and nominative in position as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿فكيف كان عذابي ونذر﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna; وكان عذابي: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, عذاب is its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); نذر is conjoined to عذابي, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the omitted first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿فكيف كان...﴾ has no grammatical position because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿ولقد يسرنا القرآن للذكر﴾: ﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw: resumptive; the lām: falling in the answer to an implied oath; قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿يسرنا﴾ is a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿القرآن﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿للذكر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسرنا﴾; the clause ﴿لقد يسرنا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the implied oath; and the implied oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فهل من مدكر﴾: ﴿فهل﴾: the fāʾ: conjunctive, and هل: an interrogative particle; ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; and ﴿مدكر﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative in position and genitive by ﴿من﴾ in form, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿كذبت عاد﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿فكيف كان عذابي ونذر﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna; وكان عذابي: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, عذاب is its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); نذر is conjoined to عذابي, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the omitted first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿إنا أرسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا في يوم نحس مستمر﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause أرسلنا عليهم is its khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ريحًا is the object of أرسلنا; صرصرًا is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ريحًا﴾; and مستمر is a naʿt of النحس or of اليوم.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿تنزع الناس كأنهم أعجاز نخل منقعر﴾: the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ريحًا﴾; كأن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; أعجاز نخل is its khabar (predicate); منقعر is a naʿt of نخل; and the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and it is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿فكيف كان عذابي ونذر﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna; وكان عذابي: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, عذاب is its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); نذر is conjoined to عذابي, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the omitted first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ولقد يسرنا القرآن للذكر﴾: ﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw: resumptive; the lām: falling in the answer to an implied oath; قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿يسرنا﴾ is a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿القرآن﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿للذكر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسرنا﴾; the clause ﴿لقد يسرنا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the implied oath; and the implied oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فهل من مدكر﴾: ﴿فهل﴾: the fāʾ: conjunctive, and هل: an interrogative particle; ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; and ﴿مدكر﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative in position and genitive by ﴿من﴾ in form, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿كذبت ثمود بالنذر﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); and بالنذر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فقالوا أبشرا منا واحدا نتبعه﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; قالوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); أبشرًا: the hamza is interrogative, and بشرًا is accusative by al-ishtighāl (the verb being occupied with a pronoun of the noun), i.e. by an implicit verb indicated by what follows it, i.e.: أنتبع بشرًا (shall we follow a human being?); منا is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿بشرًا﴾; واحدًا has two possible analyses, the more apparent of which is that it is a naʿt of ﴿بشرًا﴾, except that it is problematic in that the interpreted (phrasal) adjective is placed before the explicit adjective; the answer to this is that منا in that case is not an adjective but a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿واحدًا﴾ placed before it; the second analysis is that it is accusative as a ḥāl from the hāʾ in نتبعه, and بشر applies to the singular and the plural; and نتبعه is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إنا إذا لفي ضلال وسعر﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; إذًا is a particle of answer and requital, inoperative (muhmal); لفي: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); وفي ضلال is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna; and سعر is conjoined to ضلال.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿أؤلقي الذكر عليه من بيننا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); ألقي is a past verb, passive (built for the one whose agent is not named); الذكر is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); وعليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ألقي; and من بيننا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in عليه, i.e.: singled out.
﴿بل هو كذاب أشر﴾: بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject); كذاب is the khabar (predicate); and أشر is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿سيعلمون غدا من الكذاب الأشر﴾: the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying) of an omitted verb of saying, its implied form being: the Exalted said. The sīn is for the future; يعلمون is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); غدًا is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يعلمون﴾; من is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); الكذاب is its khabar (predicate); الأشر is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause, suspended (muʿallaqa) because the interrogative stands at its head, fills the place of the two objects of يعلمون.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿إنا مرسلو الناقة فتنة لهم فارتقبهم واصطبر﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; مرسلو الناقة is its khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; فتنة is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ولهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فتنة; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); ارتقبهم is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); اصطبر is conjoined to ارتقبهم; and what ﴿واصطبر﴾ is attached to is omitted, i.e.: and be patient with their harm.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿ونبئهم أن الماء قسمة بينهم كل شرب محتضر﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; نبئهم is an imperative verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being: أنت (you); the hāʾ is the first object; أن with what falls in its scope stands in the place of the second and third objects, because نبّأ takes three objects in the accusative; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الماء is its noun; قسمة is its khabar (predicate); بينهم is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of قسمة, or to قسمة itself, because it has the meaning of مقسومة (divided); كل is a mubtadaʾ (subject); شرب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and محتضر is the khabar of كل.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿فنادوا صاحبهم فتعاطى فعقر﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; نادوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); and what it is conjoined to is omitted, i.e.: so they persisted in that; it is better that it be the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); صاحبهم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فتعاطى is conjoined to فنادوا; and فعقر is conjoined to تعاطى.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿فكيف كان عذابي ونذر﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna; وكان عذابي: كان is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere in this book كان is parsed as a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb], عذاب is its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); نذر is conjoined to عذابي, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the omitted first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿إنا أرسلنا عليهم صيحة واحدة فكانوا كهشيم المحتظر﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause أرسلنا is its khabar (predicate); وعليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; صيحة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); واحدة is a naʿt (adjective); فكانوا is conjoined to أرسلنا, and the wāw is the noun of kāna; ﴿كهشيم﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the khabar of kāna; ﴿هشيم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and المحتظر is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿ولقد يسرنا القرآن للذكر﴾: ﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw: resumptive; the lām: falling in the answer to an implied oath; قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿يسرنا﴾ is a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿القرآن﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿للذكر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسرنا﴾; the clause ﴿لقد يسرنا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the implied oath; and the implied oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فهل من مدكر﴾: ﴿فهل﴾: the fāʾ: conjunctive, and هل: an interrogative particle; ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; and ﴿مدكر﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative in position and genitive by ﴿من﴾ in form, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿كذبت قوم لوط بالنذر﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); and بالنذر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿إنا أرسلنا عليهم حاصبا إلا آل لوط نجيناهم بسحر﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause أرسلنا is its khabar (predicate); وعليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; حاصبًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of exception; آل لوط is the excepted (mustathnā) by إلا. There are two views on this exception: the first is that it is connected (muttaṣil), the meaning being that He sent the storm of stones upon all of them except his family, for it was not sent upon them; the second is that it is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), the meaning being that it was not sent upon the family of Lūṭ; the correct view is the first. نجيناهم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and بسحر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجيناهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿نعمة من عندنا كذلك نجزي من شكر﴾: نعمة is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the implied form being: We bestowed upon Lūṭ and those with him a bestowal; or it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ﴿من عندنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of نعمة; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; نجزي is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); من is a relative, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause شكر is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿ولقد أنذرهم بطشتنا فتماروا بالنذر﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); أنذرهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بطشتنا is a second mafʿūl bihi, or it is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ) — two views; the fāʾ is a conjunction; تماروا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and وبالنذر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تماروا﴾.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿ولقد راودوه عن ضيفه فطمسنا أعينهم﴾: the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause; the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿راودوه﴾ is a past verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عن ضيفه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿راودوه﴾; ﴿فطمسنا﴾ is a past verb conjoined to ﴿راودوه﴾, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil, and ﴿أعينهم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ is conjunctive, and what it conjoins is omitted, i.e.: so We said to them.
﴿فذوقوا عذابي ونذر﴾: the fāʾ is in the answer to an implied condition; ﴿ذوقوا﴾ is the imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; ﴿عذابي﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with a fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); نذر: like ﴿عذابي﴾, and the omitted yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the implied condition, i.e.: if you persist in disbelief, then taste; and the whole conditional sentence is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying).

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿ولقد صبحهم بكرة عذاب مستقر﴾: also conjoined; بكرة is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿صبحهم﴾, i.e.: without (it being) a specific day; عذاب is the fāʿil (agent); and مستقر is a naʿt (adjective) of عذاب, i.e.: it does not leave them.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿فذوقوا عذابي ونذر﴾: the fāʾ is in the answer to an implied condition; the imperative verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); عذابي is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with a fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); نذر: like عذابي, and the omitted yāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the implied condition, i.e.: if you persist in disbelief, then taste; and the whole conditional sentence is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying).

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿ولقد يسرنا القرآن للذكر﴾: ﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw: resumptive; the lām: falling in the answer to an implied oath; قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿يسرنا﴾ is a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿القرآن﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿للذكر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسرنا﴾; the clause ﴿لقد يسرنا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the implied oath; and the implied oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فهل من مدكر﴾: ﴿فهل﴾: the fāʾ: conjunctive, and هل: an interrogative particle; ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; and ﴿مدكر﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative in position and genitive by ﴿من﴾ in form, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing).

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿ولقد جاء آل فرعون النذر﴾: ﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw: resumptive; the lām: falling in the answer to an implied oath; قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿جاء﴾ is a past verb; ﴿آل﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فرعون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote; ﴿النذر﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma; the clause ﴿لقد جاء﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the implied oath; and the implied oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿كذبوا بآياتنا كلها فأخذناهم أخذ عزيز مقتدر﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; كذبوا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); وبآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبوا﴾; كلها is a tawkīd (emphasis) of آياتنا; فأخذناهم: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and ﴿أخذناهم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وأخذ: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); وعزيز: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ومقتدر: a naʿt (adjective) of عزيز; and the annexation is of the type of annexing the maṣdar (verbal noun) to its fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿أكفاركم خير من أولئكم﴾: أكفاركم: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī), which has the meaning of negation; كفاركم is a mubtadaʾ (subject); خير is the khabar (predicate); and ومن أوليائكم [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the ayah is أولئكم] is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير.
﴿أم لكم براءة في الزبر﴾: أم: disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), meaning «بل» plus the hamza of the interrogative of disapproval, the implied form being: بل ألكم براءة ...؟ (rather, do you have an immunity …?); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; براءة is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and ﴿في الزبر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of براءة.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿أم يقولون نحن جميع منتصر﴾: أم: disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), meaning «بل» plus the interrogative hamza, or meaning «بل» only; ﴿يقولون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); نحن is a mubtadaʾ (subject); جميع is the khabar (predicate); منتصر is a naʿt (adjective) of جميع, because it has the meaning of a group (jamʿ); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying); منتصر was made singular only to match the wording of ﴿جميع﴾, for it is singular in wording even though it is a noun for a group, like الرهط (band) and الجيش (army).

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿سيهزم الجمع ويولون الدبر﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future; يهزم is an imperfect verb, passive (built for the one whose agent is not named); الجمع is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); يولون is conjoined to سيهزم; and الدبر is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿بل الساعة موعدهم والساعة أدهى وأمر﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; الساعة is a mubtadaʾ (subject); موعدهم is the khabar (predicate); the wāw is a conjunction; الساعة is a mubtadaʾ; أدهى is the khabar; and أمر is conjoined to الساعة [Translator's note: so in the source; أمرّ is conjoined to أدهى]; and you may make the wāw circumstantial (of the ḥāl).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t: ﴿إن المجرمين في ضلال وسعر﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); المجرمين is its noun; وفي ضلال is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); سعر is conjoined (maʿṭūf) by the wāw, genitive (majrūr) with the kasra; and the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿يوم يسحبون في النار على وجوههم﴾: يوم: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb of saying, i.e.: it will be said to them on the day they are dragged; the clause يسحبون is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; وفي النار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسحبون﴾; and وعلى وجوههم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ذوقوا مس سقر﴾: ذوقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying) of the implied verb of saying; مس is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and سقر is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); it is a proper name for Hell, and therefore it is a diptote, because it is a feminine proper name.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿إنا كل شيء خلقناه بقدر﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; كل شيء is accusative by al-ishtighāl (the verb being occupied with a pronoun of the noun), by an omitted verb indicated by what follows it, i.e.: إنا خلقنا كل شيء خلقناه (We created everything; We created it); the clause of the omitted verb is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause خلقناه is explicative, with no grammatical position; and وبقدر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from كل, i.e.: measured, precise, ordered.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿وما أمرنا إلا واحدة كلمح بالبصر﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ما is negating; أمرنا is a mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); واحدة is the khabar (predicate) of أمرنا; وكلمح is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from what the command relates to, namely the thing commanded to come into being, i.e.: in the state of its coming into being swiftly; and وبالبصر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to لمح.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿ولقد أهلكنا أشياعكم﴾: ﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw: resumptive; the lām: falling in the answer to an implied oath; قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿أهلكنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿أشياعكم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the second-person pronoun is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿لقد أهلكنا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the implied oath; and the implied oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فهل من مدكر﴾: ﴿فهل﴾: the fāʾ: conjunctive, and هل: an interrogative particle; ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; and ﴿مدكر﴾ is genitive in form and nominative in position as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿وكل شيء فعلوه في الزبر﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; كل is a mubtadaʾ (subject); شيء is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause فعلوه is a naʿt (adjective); and في الزبر is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿وكل صغير وكبير مستطر﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; كل is a mubtadaʾ (subject); صغير is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the kasra; كبير is conjoined (maʿṭūf) by the wāw, genitive with the kasra; مستطر is the khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma; and the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the one before it.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿إن المتقين في جنات ونهر﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); المتقين is its noun; وفي جنات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); and نهر is conjoined to جنات.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿في مقعد صدق﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) of part for whole (badal baʿḍ min kull) from His words: في جنات, because the seat is part of the gardens; and you may attach it (mutaʿalliq) to something omitted, as a second khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿عند مليك﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of جنات, or of مقعد; and it has been said: it is a second or third khabar of inna; مليك is an intensive form (ṣīghat mubālagha).
﴿مقتدر﴾: a naʿt; and the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive.
